slot_scores.name: single_vehicle_per_customer
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked whether a customer's demand can be split across multiple vehicles or must be served entirely by one vehicle. Its capacity question only addressed route-level capacity, not single-vehicle assignment.

slot_scores.name: depot_return_requirement
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask whether vehicles must return to the depot or whether routes may be open. The incomplete question about 'the depot' only elicited depot location and time window, not the return requirement.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The conversation ended without a clear READY_TO_MODEL or equivalent final modeling/final answer state. Both P1 hidden slots remained unresolved.

summary: The agent asked several basic parameter-confirmation questions but never addressed the hidden single-vehicle-per-customer or depot-return requirements, then degraded into repeated incomplete questions and did not reach a final modeling state.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
